name: detect termination by an acknowledgement tree
mechanism: every message that activates a node makes the sender its parent; a node acknowledges its parent only when it is idle and has received acknowledgements for every message it sent; the root's last acknowledgement means the whole computation has terminated

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Dijkstra-Scholten algorithm' in section Distributed systems algorithms:

fails_when: one lost acknowledgement means never detecting termination
